display_information.name: Broadcastwell
display_information.description: See which AI engines name your company, and who they name instead.
display_information.long_description: Broadcastwell measures whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode name your company when buyers ask shortlist questions. Type /broadcastwell status to see your latest scheduled run: how many answers named you, out of how many, with the 95% interval. Type /broadcastwell sample to try it on the fictional Kalvenor Systems sample without an account. /broadcastwell connect links the workspace to your Broadcastwell account through a sign in you approve; the link reads only and you can disconnect it at any time.

slash_commands.description: Your latest scheduled run, or the fictional sample
